mentions.name: SolarCube
mentions.description: A fully off-grid, solar-powered data center built in a desert, running on solar panels, batteries, and a Starlink uplink. It initially focuses on hosting AI inference workloads; a first prototype is being built and cooling solutions are being tested.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Solar-powered data center in a desert.

Fully off-grid using solar, batteries and Starlink for uplink. Focusing on AI inference at the beginning. Currently building our first prototype and testing cooling solutions.
